instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 on the Regulation of Labour Relations
instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

summary.en: No one may work, and no employer may recruit or employ a worker, without a MOHRE work permit. Recruitment and employment agencies need a MOHRE licence, and the employer may not charge the worker recruitment or employment fees, directly or indirectly.
summary.zh: 未取得人力资源和本地化部（MOHRE）工作许可，任何人不得在阿联酋工作，雇主也不得招聘或雇用工人。招聘和中介机构须经 MOHRE 许可；雇主不得直接或间接向工人收取招聘或雇用费用。

instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 on the Regulation of Labour Relations

summary.en: The employer must sign a written contract in the MOHRE form, in two copies (one for each party). Contracts are for a fixed, renewable term; the worker may prove the contract and wage by any means.
summary.zh: 雇主须按 MOHRE 规定格式与工人签订书面合同，一式两份，双方各执一份。合同为固定期限、可续签；工人可用任何方式证明合同及工资。

instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

summary.en: Probation may not exceed six months and may be used only once with the same employer. The employer may end employment during probation with at least 14 days' written notice.
summary.zh: 试用期不超过六个月，同一雇主只能约定一次。试用期内雇主解除劳动关系须至少提前14天书面通知。

instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

summary.en: The employer may not retain the worker's official documents or force the worker to leave the country when the employment ends.
summary.zh: 雇主不得扣押工人的官方证件，也不得在劳动关系结束时强迫工人离境。

summary.en: The employer must provide suitable accommodation licensed by the competent authorities, or pay a housing allowance, or include housing in the wage.
summary.zh: 雇主须提供经主管部门许可的合适住宿，或支付住房津贴，或将住房费用计入工资。

summary.en: The employer must provide the means of protection against work injuries and occupational diseases, safety guidance and awareness material, suitable training, and periodic assessment that all parties meet occupational safety and health requirements.
summary.zh: 雇主须提供防范工伤和职业病的防护措施、安全指引和宣传资料、适当培训，并定期评估各方是否满足职业安全与健康要求。

heading.en: Worker's duty to follow safety instructions
heading.zh: 工人遵守安全指令的义务

summary.en: The worker must carry out the occupational safety and health instructions in force at the establishment.
summary.zh: 工人须执行单位内现行的职业安全与健康指令。

instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

summary.en: Normal working hours may not exceed 8 hours a day or 48 hours a week. The Cabinet may raise or lower them for certain sectors or categories and set hours in which work is banned for some categories; commuting time does not count except for categories set by the Executive Regulation, which also sets Ramadan hours.
summary.zh: 正常工作时间每天不超过8小时、每周不超过48小时。内阁可对特定行业或工种增减工时，并规定某些工种禁止工作的时段；通勤时间除实施条例规定的工种外不计入工时；斋月工时由实施条例规定。

instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

heading.zh: 连续工作五小时须休息

summary.en: A worker may not work more than 5 consecutive hours without one or more breaks totalling at least one hour, which do not count as working time. Shift and field work are organised under the Executive Regulation.
summary.zh: 工人连续工作不得超过5小时，其间须有合计不少于1小时的休息，休息时间不计入工时。轮班和现场岗位按实施条例安排。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE)
version: Arabic text published by Dubai Municipality (dm.gov.ae)
currency_note: In force since 2 Feb 2022. instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 on the Regulation of Labour Relations
instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

summary.en: Overtime may not exceed 2 hours a day, and total working time may not exceed 144 hours in 3 weeks. Overtime earns the basic-wage rate plus at least 25%; overtime between 10 pm and 4 am earns at least 50% extra (shift workers excepted). Work on the rest day is compensated by another rest day or pay plus at least 50%.
summary.zh: 加班每天不超过2小时，且每3周总工时不超过144小时。加班工资按基本工资计算并加付至少25%；晚10时至凌晨4时的加班加付至少50%（轮班工人除外）。休息日工作须另补休息日，或按正常工资加付至少50%。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE)

instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

summary.en: The worker is entitled to at least one paid rest day a week, as set by the contract or work rules; the Cabinet may increase it.
summary.zh: 工人每周至少享有一天带薪休息日，具体按合同或工作规章确定；内阁可增加休息日。

instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 on the Regulation of Labour Relations
instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

heading.en: Wages paid on time through approved systems
heading.zh: 按时通过认可系统支付工资

summary.en: The wage must be stated in the contract. The employer must pay wages when due through the systems approved by the Ministry (the Wage Protection System), in UAE dirhams unless another currency is agreed.
summary.zh: 工资须在合同中载明。雇主须在到期时通过部里认可的系统（工资保护系统）支付工资，除另有约定外以阿联酋迪拉姆支付。

instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 on the Regulation of Labour Relations
instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

summary.en: Establishments must comply with Federal Law No. 13 of 2020 on Public Health and its implementing decisions; the Executive Regulation sets the Ministry's role and the rules on worker safety, protection and health care.
summary.zh: 各单位须遵守2020年第13号联邦公共卫生法及其实施决定；部里的职责以及工人安全、防护和医疗保健的具体规定由实施条例规定。

instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 on the Regulation of Labour Relations
instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

heading.en: Work injury and occupational disease compensation

summary.en: The employer bears treatment costs until recovery or proven disability, pays full wage during treatment for up to 6 months, then half wage for a further 6 months or until recovery, disability or death. For a death, the family receives 24 months' basic wage, at least AED 18,000 and at most AED 200,000.
summary.zh: 雇主承担治疗费用直至康复或确认伤残；治疗期间前6个月支付全额工资，此后再支付最多6个月半薪，直至康复、确认伤残或死亡。工人因工死亡的，其家属获得相当于24个月基本工资的补偿，最低1.8万、最高20万迪拉姆。

authority: Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE)

instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 on the Regulation of Labour Relations
instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

heading.en: When injury compensation is not due

summary.en: No injury compensation is due if investigation shows the worker injured himself deliberately, was under the influence of alcohol or drugs, deliberately broke prevention instructions posted visibly at the workplace, committed deliberate misconduct, or refused examination or treatment without good reason.
summary.zh: 经主管部门调查证实工人故意自伤、受酒精或毒品影响、故意违反在工作场所显著位置张贴的预防指令、故意不当行为，或无正当理由拒绝检查或治疗的，不予工伤补偿。

instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 on the Regulation of Labour Relations
instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

heading.en: Dismissal without notice for safety breaches
heading.zh: 违反安全规定可无通知解雇

summary.en: After a written investigation, the employer may dismiss a worker without notice, by a reasoned written decision, for breaching the establishment's written and visibly posted rules on work and worker safety that the worker was made aware of.
summary.zh: 经书面调查后，工人违反单位书面并显著张贴、且已告知其本人的作业及工人安全规定的，雇主可书面说明理由后不经预告解雇。

instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

summary.en: A foreign full-time worker with one year or more of continuous service earns a gratuity on the basic wage: 21 days' wage for each of the first five years and 30 days' wage for each year after that.
summary.zh: 连续服务满一年的外籍全职工人，离职时按基本工资领取服务期满酬金：前五年每年21天工资，此后每年30天工资。

instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 on the Regulation of Labour Relations
instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

summary.en: A party to a labour dispute must first apply to MOHRE for amicable settlement. MOHRE decides claims of up to AED 50,000 (or breaches of an earlier settlement); either party may bring the case to the court of first instance within 15 working days, which suspends the decision.
summary.zh: 劳动争议一方须先向 MOHRE 申请友好解决。争议金额不超过5万迪拉姆（或涉及不履行此前和解决定）的，由 MOHRE 作出决定；任一方可在15个工作日内向初审法院起诉，起诉后该决定暂停执行。

instrument_zh: 2021年第33号联邦法令（劳动关系规范法）

summary.en: MOHRE officials authorised by the Minister of Justice have judicial-officer powers to record breaches of the Decree-Law, enter establishments and draw up violation reports.
summary.zh: 经司法部长授权的 MOHRE 官员具有司法警察权限，可记录违反本法令的行为、进入相关单位并制作违规笔录。

instrument_zh: 2025年第25号联邦法令（民事交易法）

summary.en: A muqawala is a contract by which one party undertakes to make a thing or perform work for a consideration that the other party undertakes to pay.
summary.zh: 承揽合同是一方承诺制作某物或完成某项工作、另一方承诺支付对价的合同。

authority: UAE Federal Government (Ministry of Justice)
version: In force 1 June 2026; Arabic text (dm.gov.ae)
currency_note: Replaces Federal Law No. 5 of 1985 from 1 June 2026; transitional rules for contracts signed earlier are not summarised. The PDF text layer drops some Arabic letters, so each summary was checked against the meaning of the whole article. Many muqawala rules yield to the contract, but the decennial liability cannot be excluded (Art. 823).

instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 25 of 2025 issuing the Civil Transactions Law
instrument_zh: 2025年第25号联邦法令（民事交易法）

summary.en: The contract must describe the subject of the work, its type, quantity and method of performance, the completion period, and the consideration.
summary.zh: 合同须载明工作标的、类型、数量、履行方式、完工期限及对价。

summary.en: Where the contractor supplies materials, they must meet the contract conditions or, failing these, prevailing custom, and the contractor guarantees their quality to the employer.
summary.zh: 承包方提供材料的，材料须符合合同条件，合同未约定的按通行惯例，承包方对材料质量向业主负担保责任。

heading.zh: 业主提供的材料及缺陷

summary.en: The contractor must look after employer-supplied materials with ordinary care, follow technical practice, return what is left and pay for materials ruined by its negligence. It must notify the employer at once of defects in those materials or other factors that hinder proper performance, or bear the consequences.
summary.zh: 对业主提供的材料，承包方须尽一般注意义务妥善保管、遵循技术规范、退还剩余材料，并赔偿因其过失而不能使用的材料。发现这些材料有缺陷或存在妨碍正常施工的其他因素时须立即通知业主，否则自行承担后果。

summary.en: Unless the contract or custom provides otherwise, the contractor provides at its own cost the additional tools and equipment needed to complete the work.
summary.zh: 除合同或惯例另有规定外，承包方自费提供完成工作所需的额外工具和设备。

heading.en: Completion, notice to correct and termination
heading.zh: 完工、限期整改与解除合同

summary.en: The contractor must finish the work per the contract within the agreed period, or a reasonable one. If the work is defective or non-compliant, the employer may give notice to correct within a reasonable time and then terminate and hand completion or correction to another contractor at the first contractor's cost. Immediate termination is allowed where defects cannot be cured or delay makes timely completion hopeless.
summary.zh: 承包方须按合同在约定期限内完工，未约定的在合理期限内完工。工作有缺陷或不符合合同的，业主可通知其在合理期限内整改；逾期未改的，可解除合同并交由其他承包方完成或整改，费用由原承包方承担。缺陷无法补救，或延误已使按期完工无望的，可立即解除合同。

instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 25 of 2025 issuing the Civil Transactions Law

summary.en: The contractor is liable for damage or loss caused by its act or work, whether by transgression or default, unless it results from an event that could not be guarded against.
summary.zh: 承包方对其行为或工作造成的损害或损失承担责任，无论出于侵害还是过失；但由无法防范的事件造成的除外。

instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 25 of 2025 issuing the Civil Transactions Law
instrument_zh: 2025年第25号联邦法令（民事交易法）

heading.zh: 十年责任（建筑物安全保证）

summary.en: Where an engineer designs and a contractor builds buildings or fixed structures under the engineer's supervision, both are jointly liable for 10 years for total or partial collapse, even if caused by defective ground or allowed by the employer, and for defects that threaten the building's stability and safety. The period runs from handover to the employer.
summary.zh: 由工程师设计、承包方在其监督下建造建筑物或其他固定构筑物的，二者对10年内发生的全部或部分倒塌承担连带责任，即使倒塌源于地基缺陷或业主同意按缺陷建造；对危及建筑物结构稳定与安全的缺陷同样负责。责任期自业主接收时起算。

instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 25 of 2025 issuing the Civil Transactions Law
instrument_zh: 2025年第25号联邦法令（民事交易法）

heading.zh: 仅负责设计或仅负责监督的工程师

summary.en: An engineer who only prepared the design is liable for design defects, not for execution defects; an engineer who only supervised is jointly liable with the contractor for execution defects under its supervision.
summary.zh: 仅负责设计的工程师只对设计缺陷负责，不对施工方式造成的缺陷负责；仅负责监督施工的工程师，对其监督下的施工缺陷与承包方承担连带责任。

heading.zh: 排除十年责任的条款无效

summary.en: Any clause intended to exempt the engineer or contractor from, or limit, this liability is void.
summary.zh: 任何旨在免除或限制工程师或承包方上述责任的条款均无效。

summary.zh: 此类索赔自倒塌发生或缺陷被发现之日起超过3年的，不予受理。

instrument_zh: 2025年第25号联邦法令（民事交易法）

heading.zh: 按单价计量合同的超量

summary.en: If, under a unit-rate estimate, it becomes necessary to exceed the estimated quantities significantly, the contractor must notify the employer of the expected price increase or lose the right to recover the excess. If the excess is onerous, the employer may withdraw and stop the work without delay, paying for work done.
summary.zh: 按单价估算签订的合同，施工中如必须大幅超出估算工程量，承包方须通知业主并说明预计增加的价款，否则丧失追偿超出部分费用的权利。超出过大的，业主可立即退出合同并停工，但须支付已完工程价款。

instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 25 of 2025 issuing the Civil Transactions Law
instrument_zh: 2025年第25号联邦法令（民事交易法）

heading.en: Lump-sum price, variations and exceptional circumstances
heading.zh: 总价合同、变更与特殊情势

summary.en: Under a lump sum for an agreed design, the contractor cannot claim more because material or labour prices rise, nor for design changes unless caused by the employer's fault or authorised by it with an agreed price increase. If general exceptional circumstances that could not be foreseen upset the contractual balance, the court may restore it, including by extending time or adjusting the price, or terminate the contract.
summary.zh: 按约定设计签订总价合同的，承包方不得因材料价格或人工上涨而要求加价；设计变更也不得加价，除非变更源于业主过错，或经业主许可并约定加价。因订约时无法预见的一般性特殊情势导致合同失衡的，法院可恢复合同平衡，包括延长工期或调整价款，也可判决解除合同。

summary.en: The contractor may subcontract all or part of the work unless the contract forbids it or the nature of the work requires the contractor to do it personally; the contractor remains liable to the employer for the subcontractor.
summary.zh: 除合同禁止或工作性质要求承包方亲自履行外，承包方可将全部或部分工作分包；承包方仍就分包方向业主负责。

heading.zh: 分包方向业主主张权利

summary.en: A subcontractor may not claim from the employer anything owed to the main contractor unless the main contractor has assigned it to the employer.
summary.zh: 除总承包方将债权转让给业主外，分包方不得向业主主张总承包方应得的款项。

instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 25 of 2025 issuing the Civil Transactions Law
instrument_zh: 2025年第25号联邦法令（民事交易法）

summary.en: The employer may withdraw and stop the work at any time before completion, compensating the contractor for expenses, work done and the profit it would have earned; the court may reduce the lost-profit element where fair, deducting savings and other earnings.
summary.zh: 业主可在完工前随时退出合同并停工，但须赔偿承包方已支出的费用、已完工程价款及完工可得利润；在公平的情况下法院可减少利润损失部分，并扣除承包方因此节省的费用和另行获得的收入。

heading.en: Destruction of the work by force majeure
heading.zh: 不可抗力导致工作物灭失

summary.en: If the thing perishes by force majeure before delivery, the contractor cannot claim its price or expenses, and each party bears the loss of what it supplied; fault after a formal notice to deliver or take delivery shifts the loss to the party at fault.
summary.zh: 工作物在交付前因不可抗力灭失的，承包方不得请求报酬或费用，损失由提供该部分的一方承担；在已催告交付或接收后因一方过错灭失的，由过错方承担。
